blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Jeus Gabriel Derick Yape made it a double-podium showing for the Philippines after winning bronze in the men’s taekwondo poomsae event on Thursday at the Asian Games 2026. Yape scored 9.0900 in the final to finish third, sharing the bronze with Singapore’s Zong Han Darren Yap. South Korea’s Yun Kyusung topped the event with 9.3800, followed by Thailand’s Navin Pinthasute, who scored 9.2800 for the silver.
